integrity_note: Analytic proof of all domain claims; deterministic numeric checker provides separate corroboration for explicit harmonic examples, not independent mathematical certification. Historical originality remains subject to further independent review.
limitations: Fixed strictly convex C^4 normal-support functions with positive curvature radius, constant Euclidean width, and independent uniform boundary-arclength sampling. The result is not uniform across degenerating shapes and does not treat nonsmooth boundaries, random-line chords, interior samples or inverse recovery of a generic noncircular shape.
title: The Hellinger diameter-tail law and sharp circle rigidity for smooth constant-width ovals
